newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close up on rising retail demand.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close up on rising retail demand.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed up for a third straight session as more retail investors resumed buying blue chips, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all share price index rose 18.81 points or 0.71 percent at 2,656.65 on a turnover of 75.2 million taka. Of 91 traded issues, 61 gained and 30 lost.
"Market is again attracting retail buyers. But they look a bit cautious and targeting only good shares," said one broker.
Beximco Pharma was the volume leader with 54,400 scrips traded 10.70 taka higher at 354.12, Bangladesh Tobacco rose 13.07 to 274.48 and leasing IDLC lost 383.83 to 7,292.81.
